user.title: Apple TV Audio Output
user.description: Adds actions that send an Apple TV's sound to AirPlay speakers. The Apple TV itself must be set up with the Apple TV integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

set_output.name: Set audio output
set_output.description: Sends the Apple TV's sound to these AirPlay speakers only. Does nothing when they are already an output.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: AirPlay speakers: their AirPlay name, a media player entity with the same name, or an AirPlay id.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send the command even when the speakers are already an output.

add_output.name: Add audio output
add_output.description: Adds AirPlay speakers to the Apple TV's current audio outputs.
